create_HistoryBuffer: create a HistoryBuffer instance with a configurable max_length to track scalar values over iterations
update_HistoryBuffer: update the HistoryBuffer with a new scalar value and optional iteration number
get_latest_HistoryBuffer: get the latest scalar value added to the HistoryBuffer
compute_window_avg_HistoryBuffer: compute the mean of the latest window_size values in the HistoryBuffer
compute_global_avg_HistoryBuffer: compute the global average of all values ever added to the HistoryBuffer
